candidates.note: Rechecked 21 Sep 2026: the exact PistonHeads advert is live at £99,995, 18,460 miles and manual from Auto Torque in Buckinghamshire, and Auto Torque's current PistonHeads stock now lists this exact TME. Five exact seller photographs were visually inspected with no SOLD/RESERVED/DEPOSIT/UNDER-OFFER overlay; the cabin image clearly shows an H-pattern manual lever and three pedals. Auto Torque's own live advert also shows £99,995, 18,460 miles, 5-speed manual and 'Keepers 2'. However the seller states the car was imported from Japan in 2009 and only describes UK ownership; pre-import Japanese ownership history is not evidenced. The Mitsubishi rule requires verified total ownership including pre-import use, and unknown ownership fails. Reject from publication.
